features.name: Bonus Action Spell

effects.note: You can cast any spell you know at 1st level or higher as a bonus action on any of your turns, instead of as an action. This can't be used on the same turn as the attack granted by your level 3 feature or a shove.

features.summary: Cast any 1st-level or higher known spell as a bonus action
features.text: You can cast any spell you know at 1st level or higher as a bonus action on any of your turns, instead of as an action. This can't be used on the same turn as the attack granted by your level 3 feature.

features.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting

effects.note: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a d20 to make an attack roll with a weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.summary: Reroll a 1 or 2 on two-handed weapon attacks
features.text: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a d20 to make an attack roll with a weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Mirror: Elegant Robe

effects.note: You can cast dimension door without a spell slot, and you can use it on your turn as a bonus action. While you wear a robe, your armor class equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier, ignoring all other modifiers, as long as the robe is worth at least 50 gp and is not being worn by another creature on your turn.

features.summary: Cast dimension door as a bonus action; robe sets AC to 13 plus Dex
features.text: You can cast dimension door without a spell slot, and you can use it on your turn as a bonus action. While you wear a robe, your armor class equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier, ignoring all other modifiers, as long as the robe is worth at least 50 gp and is not being worn by another creature on your turn.

features.name: Tusked Fury

effects.note: You can make a bonus action tusk attack using your Strength modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier.

features.summary: Bonus action tusk attack, 1d6 plus Str
features.text: You can make a bonus action tusk attack using your Strength modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier.

source.reference: PHB Druid Circle of the Moon 2

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Bones of the Earth cantrip, and BA cast of a prepared spell
features.text: Your spellcasting ability is Wisdom. You know the bones of the earth cantrip. You have a list of druid spells known to you from the druid spell list, and your known spells are the same number as in the druid class table. You can also cast any spell you have prepared without a spell slot, once per long rest, by using a bonus action on any of your turns.

source.reference: PHB Druid Circle of the Moon 2

features.name: Rage

effects.note: While in a beast form, you can cast spells, and a bonus action spell can be cast in the same turn. Your spellcasting ability is Wisdom, and you are limited to the beast's Wisdom score or your own, whichever is higher.

features.summary: Cast spells while shapeshifted, including bonus action spells
features.text: You are able to cast spells while in your beast form, and you can cast a spell as a bonus action on any turn. While transformed, your Wisdom score is the higher of your own Wisdom or the transformed form's Wisdom.

source.reference: PHB Druid Circle of the Moon 3

features.name: Psychic Whispers

effects.note: As a bonus action, you whisper a message in a creature's ear. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 8 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus, or, on a failure, choose one of the following effects, until the end of your next turn: The target doesn't move. The target doesn't make an attack. The target doesn't cast a spell. The target doesn't use or speak a language.

features.summary: Bonus action: forbid one thing a creature can do this turn
features.text: As a bonus action, you whisper a message in a creature's ear. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw or, on a failure, choose one of the following effects, until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Hex Ward

effects.note: You have a +1 bonus to AC and your Constitution modifier to hit points per hexblade level, because your curse grants you additional durability. You can also wield medium armor and gain proficiency with it.

features.summary: +1 AC, Con to HP per level, and medium armor proficiency
features.text: You have a +1 bonus to AC and your Constitution modifier to hit points per hexblade level, because your curse grants you additional durability. You also gain proficiency with medium armor.

features.name: Hex

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to mark one creature, which lasts until you finish a long rest or until you use it again. When you mark a creature, you gain advantage on Charisma checks to interact with it and on your first attack roll against it after you cast. The target makes a Charisma saving throw, and on a failure is charmed by you until the duration ends or you willingly end it, and automatically fails its save to avoid being charmed. A charmed creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed.

features.summary: Once a long rest, charm a creature for an hour
features.text: You can use a bonus action to mark one creature, which lasts until you finish a long rest or until you use it again. When you mark a creature, you gain advantage on Charisma checks to interact with it and on your first attack roll against it after you cast. The target makes a Charisma saving throw, and on a failure is charmed by you.

features.name: Draconic Breath

effects.note: Replace the damage type with the type of your dragon ancestry, and the 3d6 with 4d6 at 14th level. You can replace it with a d6 of your choice, gained at 6th level.

features.summary: A 15-foot cone of your ancestry's damage, Dex save for half
features.text: You can spend 1 sorcery point to gain a pool of 1d6 in your Bloodline that you can spend to deal an extra 1d6 of damage of your Bloodline's type when you cast any spell. You can also spend 1 sorcery point to cast dragon's breath, a 15-foot cone of your ancestry's damage, 3d6, which you replace with a d6 of your choice. Each time you cast it, you must make a Dexterity saving throw or take the damage yourself.
